verdict.rationale: Controlling whether merchant or customer data is used for AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS ecommerce platform that ships AI features, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers an AI training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any AI-specific privacy control. The AI-related items (AI-powered docs search and chat, and llms.txt) are about developer documentation tooling, not data-training controls.
